bull.b: Sustained, large positive free cash flow (~$679M TTM) provides durable internal funding for growth, share repurchases, and the Predictions buildout without immediate reliance on capital markets. Return to positive net income and meaningful adjusted EBITDA improvement signal durable operating leverage and improved unit economics. bull.t: Product ownership & geographic expansion (DKeX, Alberta launch)
bull.b: Owning the DKeX exchange and expanding into new jurisdictions increases product differentiation, content control, and operating economics. bear.b: High absolute debt versus a relatively small equity base limits financial flexibility and raises refinancing risk if cash flow weakens. Even with improving operations, elevated leverage constrains capital allocation choices and increases sensitivity to adverse cycles or larger-than-expected Predictions investments.

Low net and EBITDA margins leave little buffer for promotional spend, hold variance, or product mix shifts. Gaming revenue is outcome-dependent and historically volatile; modest margins heighten the risk that promotional or acquisition spending will erode profits and cash flow if growth slows or unit economics worsen.

Rapid Predictions expansion faces two structural risks: regulatory scrutiny of prediction markets and early user-loss patterns that could trigger consumer-protection actions. Both could increase compliance costs, limit product availability, or slow adoption, while the planned $200–$300M investment raises execution and recurrence uncertainty.
